title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
description:
All numbers are positive. Return the length of the shortest run of numbers in a row whose sum is at least target, or 0 if there is none.

target = 7, nums = [2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3] → 2 ([4, 3])
tracePrompt: Trace of target = 7, [2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3]: one row per number added
